authoring: Physics and world components with retained runtime bindings

behaviors.description: Select Jointed Box and edit its compound collider, joint distance, local anchors, limits and break threshold.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The retained native constraint receives live edits; a broken component joint remains broken until rearmed by disable/re-enable or Stop.

behaviors.description: Play, pause and single-step. Compare the rope, hanging body and small cloth lattice.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Gravity pulls the dynamic bodies; constraints retain their authored lengths. Cloth is a body/connection lattice, without a fabric or self-collision claim.

behaviors.description: Use the rope Connection editor to change segments/material-related settings and save.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Explicit rope rebuild changes its node count; point positions and UUID anchors survive reopening.

behaviors.description: Change friction and masks; Undo/Redo; save/reopen and export.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The exact authored project reaches the exported physics runtime.

behaviors.description: Read the visible X/Y meter values while playing in editor and export.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The readout follows the subject through the ordinary Rhai transform/UI APIs at10Hz; it can be compared with the Inspector while paused.
